x = ... # some (4, 2) model input: batch size 4, feature size 2

l1 = nn.AllToShardedLinear(2, 2, bias=False)   # initialize the layer

l2 = nn.ShardedToAllLinear(2, 2, bias=False)
l2_out = l2(l1_out) # (4, 2) output
```
